findings.summary: The brief calls the alternative evidence 'a recorded Athena revert-run check', but that run is named `fails-without-<N>`, and Athena makes it only from a planned demonstration. A reader could write a criterion that names a check that never appears.
findings.evidence: verify.rs:1093-1100 `demonstration_name` gives `fails-without-<first criterion>`. verify.rs:1106-1108 says the run counts only for the criteria in `revert_for`, and only when the run finished. briefs.rs:961-1007 describes it as Athena's run of the planned "fails without the fix" demonstration. Fix: Word the sentence to match the code. For example: 'met only by the diff, or by Athena's `fails-without-<N>` run of the planned "fails without the fix" demonstration, recorded among the checks'. Make the new test assert the substring `fails-without`.

findings.summary: The root cause is already written out in the doc comment of `check_criteria_evidence` (surveys.rs:80-87). Copying it in full onto `producer_evidence_phrase` duplicates it.
findings.evidence: surveys.rs:80-87: 'Root cause this check removes: criteria were written without a defined list of what the verifier can observe ...' Fix: Criterion 2 requires the root cause on `producer_evidence_phrase`, so give it one sentence there that points to the fuller comment on `check_criteria_evidence`, and add the transcript and log nouns to that comment.

findings.summary: Two demonstrations rely on git commands (`git show`, `git diff -- CHANGELOG.md`). The verifier is limited to the commands listed for its capability, and the snapshot has no git.
findings.evidence: reader.rs:622-623: 'The verifier exercises behavior criteria only with these commands ... no other programs'. System facts: the plain copies the reader, planner and critic get have no git. Fix: For criterion 5, say the verifier reads the candidate diff or CHANGELOG.md in the snapshot. For criterion 4, drop `git show` and cite the recorded fmt, clippy and test checks (D115).

findings.summary: The 'fails on the base tree' part of criterion 3 is shown by Athena's revert run, here of the whole `cargo test --locked` suite. That run fails for both changes at once, so it cannot show which test fails because of which change, and it is costly.
findings.evidence: Criterion 3 says 'a new brief test fails on the base tree and passes now'. Demonstration 3 runs `cargo test --locked`. Revert runs are grouped by the plan's command (verify.rs:1109-1117). Fix: For criterion 3's 'fails without the fix' demonstration, name the filtered brief test: `cargo test --locked -p athena-context the_reader_brief_says_the_verifier_sees_only_the_final_tree`. Keep the full suite only for the 'passes now' part.

summary: I checked the plan against the request, the reading and the code in the snapshot. It changes the code where the cause starts. The reader writes the criteria, and its brief section `verifier_can_run_section` (crates/athena-context/src/briefs/reader.rs:618-632) lists what the verifier can see. It never says the verifier sees only the final tree and cannot run anything on the base commit. Adding that sentence gives the reader the missing information, which is the fix the request prefers. Adding two nouns to REPORT_NOUNS (surveys.rs:7) is a small widening of an existing check, and `has_phrase` matches whole words only (surveys.rs:39-45). I searched the snapshot and found no producer-log or producer-transcript wording that the new nouns would refuse; the only near matches are "producer login" and "producer's login". The plan's new tests use the existing fixture `reader_inputs` (briefs.rs:3717-3729, which renders the section), the existing helper `reading_with_criterion` (reading.rs:4539) and the real entry points, so nothing is faked. Each test would fail without its change. I grepped for every place that reads the changed text: the tests at briefs.rs:4045 and 4054 and reading.rs:4550, the refusal corpus case, and run_pin_tests. All of them are in the plan's dependents list, and none matches on the noun list or on the wording the plan changes. There are no external services, no new config keys and no commit-history work. I found only minor and nit issues: the brief's name for the revert run does not match the record name `fails-without-<N>`; the root-cause doc comment already exists on `check_criteria_evidence`; and two demonstrations use git commands even though the snapshot has no git.
